bridge_chains.explanation: Transport observables suggest activation templates, templates induce wavefront designs, and wavefront statistics become cheap observers.
Collision gadgets produce motifs, motifs become grammar atoms, and the grammar becomes a learnable macrocell alphabet.
SAT narrows legal local rules, e-graphs compress derivations, odometers rank sink geometries, and rotor schedules realize deterministic transport.
Assembly grammars yield layered scaffolds, layered scaffolds support peeling waves, and those waves can be triaged with sketches.
